prompt: Keep the real perspective and dim lighting of the first reference photo, the view from just behind the front seats forward to the windscreen, but make it the cab of a tall UK ambulance: a high, upright, wide windscreen, a dashboard with a few lit dials, the driver's seat on the RIGHT. At the right edge, the driver's dark green sleeve and black-gloved hands grip the steering wheel. Rain beads the glass, a wiper mid-sweep, our own blue roof lights flickering on the bonnet. Through the windscreen, just ahead across our lane, a police line set out like the second reference photo: two white police motorcycles with an officer standing between them, officers in yellow hi-vis; that officer faces us, gloved hand raised, palm out. Beyond them is the yellow box junction: in its far half a convoy crosses from left to right, side-on to us, a white police motorcycle leading three black saloon cars, headlights pointing right, red tail lights trailing left. Further on, to the right of the centre line, a queue faces us with headlights on, a red double-decker and cars, held at their stop line by a police officer. Vertical 9:16. Night in the rain, like a real 35 mm film photo: sodium-orange street lamps, cold teal shadows, blue emergency lights. Thanks.
